Scene: an unsettling full-height freestanding mirror in an abandoned but intact castle dressing room. The mirror has a simple dark wooden frame and two sturdy feet, broad silver-blue reflective surface. In its glass, a shadowy cloaked adventurer raises a plain sword sideways in an independent deliberate movement; only the reflection is present, no matching person outside the glass. Human proportions coherent, one visible sword, natural hand grip, no gore. A single candle on a low plain stool casts amber light across the lower frame. A hanging dull burgundy garment at one edge and large shadowed stone wall planes suggest a wardrobe room. The mirror is the subject, large enough that its uncanny reflection reads at popup size. Reflection silhouette is anonymous, NOT a recognizable current player class. Palette slate blue, muted burgundy, dark umber, bone highlights, one amber flame. Ominous stillness; avoid glowing magical swirls, broken mirror, shards, skeletal decoration.

Scene: an elderly travelling pilgrim seated on a low stone bench in a small intact castle chapel, warmly lit from a single nearby candle. New character: lined but strongly simplified kind weary face, short gray beard, plain muted olive hood resting back, ochre-brown travel cloak with a few broad folds. He leans slightly toward the viewer, one hand naturally opening a sturdy cloth sack in his lap, other hand holding ONE smooth oval memorial stone over its opening. The hand actually supports the stone with coherent fingers; sack rests on lap and bench, believable weight and contact. Several large smooth oval stones visible inside sack, with only a few subtle engraving marks, no readable letters. His expressive face, stone, and open sack form one central vertical storytelling group. Background has one broad chapel arch and empty quiet wall, no clutter, no altar icon or religious cross needed. Medium-close seated composition, head in upper quarter, sack in lower middle. Mood humane, tired dignity and a small hopeful warm light. Palette muted olive, umber, warm gray stone, bone skin highlights, restrained amber candle. Avoid a character posing for a sheet, excessive wrinkles or beard strands, piles of skulls, ornate cathedral, thick dust texture.
